# Recreation Prompt

Create **Pocket Craft Grove**, a portrait-first browser voxel sandbox inspired by Minecraft crafting. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: Three.js first-person camera, touch D-pad movement, right-side drag look, mine/place/jump buttons, selectable inventory slots, finite dirt/stone counts, infinite starter grass blocks, raycast block targeting, collision, bedrock mining denial, invalid placement denial, pause/resume, restart, and fall-below-world game over.

Transform the public presentation into a cozy mobile maker world. The player is a Pocket Crafter exploring a generated grass island, gathering soil and stone, and building freely. Use earthy pixel textures, a blocky grove sky, compact HUD chips, clear action labels, and mobile-safe controls. Do not add hunger, combat, recipes, enemies, timers, or score systems that are not present in the source.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first first-person voxel sandbox builder.
- objective: Explore a generated block island, mine reachable blocks, gather finite dirt/stone resources, place selected blocks, and keep building without falling below the world.
- input model: Touch D-pad for movement, right-side drag for look, Mine/Place/Jump buttons for actions, inventory slot taps for block selection, plus pause/restart buttons.
- core loop: Start game, spawn on terrain, look at nearby blocks, mine non-bedrock blocks for resources, place blocks adjacent to target faces, traverse and jump while collision/fall logic runs each frame.
- fail/friction state: Bedrock cannot be mined, empty finite inventory blocks cannot be placed, placement inside the player body is blocked, and falling below y=-15 triggers game over.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve Three.js voxel terrain generation, block occupancy map, block raycast selection under five units, mining/removal, placement adjacency, inventory count semantics, movement relative to camera yaw, gravity/jump/collision values, pause/restart lifecycle, audio-safe user gesture behavior, and fall failure semantics.

## Remixed target
Pocket Craft Grove: a cozy Minecraft-inspired portrait sandbox where the same first-person voxel loop becomes a pocket homestead maker experience. Presentation changes emphasize grass/soil/stone resource gathering, handcrafted block textures, a Pocket Crafter focal identity, mobile-readable HUD, and an authored grove scene while mechanics remain unchanged.
